posts.title: Dara Khosrowshahi ($UBER CEO) bought $10.0M of Uber stock
posts.alt_text: Animated walkthrough of an SEC Form 4: Dara Khosrowshahi, Uber's CEO, bought 141,000 Uber shares on Sep 10, 2026 at a weighted average of $70.9642, $10,005,952.20 in total; shares held after: 1,367,100 (+11.5%).

instagram.caption:
He runs Uber. He bought more.

Dara Khosrowshahi ($UBER CEO) bought 141,000 Uber shares on Sep 10, 2026 at a weighted average price of $70.9642. The filing says the individual purchases ranged from $70.73 to $71.18. Total: $10,005,952.20 (about $10.0M).

Direct holdings after this buy: 1,367,100 shares. That is 11.5% more than the 1,226,100 held right before it (1,367,100 − 141,000).

Source: SEC Form 4, filed Sep 10, 2026. Link in the first comment.
